moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21st, with reigning champions Arsenal facing newly promoted Coventry City in the opening fixture.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: It's back! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: New season, new hopes
angles.copy: After a summer break, the Premier League returns on August 21st! Get ready for goals, drama, and VAR debates. What's your opening weekend prediction?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The Late Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, providing a long weekend to round off the summer.

angles.name: Long weekend plans
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend is just around the corner! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer?

angles.name: Summer send-off
angles.copy: Make the most of the August Bank Holiday – it's the unofficial farewell to summer! How will you be spending it?

moments.title: All Points East Festival
moments.blurb: All Points East returns to Victoria Park, London, from August 21st-30th, featuring major headliners like Jorja Smith, Tems, Lorde, Deftones, Tyler, The Creator, and Twenty One Pilots.

angles.name: London festival vibes
angles.copy: Victoria Park is about to come alive! All Points East kicks off this weekend with a massive lineup. Who are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Stacked lineup
angles.copy: Jorja Smith, Lorde, Tyler, The Creator and more! All Points East brings the heat to London from Friday. Get ready for some incredible live music.

moments.title: Ariana Grande at The O2
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Ariana Grande continues her 'Eternal Sunshine' tour with multiple dates at London's O2 Arena this week, including August 19th, 20th, 23rd, 24th, and 27th.

angles.name: Ariana takes over London
angles.copy: She's back! Ariana Grande is lighting up The O2 Arena this week with her 'Eternal Sunshine' tour. Are you one of the lucky ones with tickets?

angles.name: Eternal Sunshine live
angles.copy: Experience the magic of Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine' live at The O2. If you're heading there, get ready for an unforgettable night!

moments.title: Lewis Capaldi in Manchester
moments.blurb: Lewis Capaldi performs a huge outdoor show at Wythenshawe Park in Manchester on Saturday, August 22nd, as part of the 'Live From Wythenshawe Park' series.

angles.name: Capaldi in Manchester
angles.copy: Manchester! Lewis Capaldi takes over Wythenshawe Park this Saturday. Who's ready for an evening of incredible ballads and banter?

angles.name: Live From Wythenshawe
angles.copy: If you're heading to see Lewis Capaldi in Manchester this weekend, get ready to sing along to all the hits. It's going to be huge!

moments.title: The Cure Headline Manchester
moments.blurb: The iconic band The Cure will headline Wythenshawe Park in Manchester on Friday, August 21st, joined by Slowdive and The Slow Readers Club.

angles.name: The Cure live
angles.copy: Manchester! The legendary The Cure are headlining Wythenshawe Park this Friday. What's your all-time favourite Cure track?

angles.name: Goth icons
angles.copy: Get ready for a night of timeless music as The Cure bring their iconic sound to Manchester's Wythenshawe Park on Friday. A must-see for rock fans!

moments.title: Green Man Festival 2026
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, a popular independent music and arts festival, takes place in the Brecon Beacons, Wales, from August 20th-23rd.

angles.name: Green Man magic
angles.copy: Brecon Beacons is buzzing! Green Man Festival kicks off on Thursday for four days of music, arts, and good vibes. Who's heading to Wales?

angles.name: Welsh festival fun
angles.copy: The Green Man Festival is back! If you're exploring the Brecon Beacons this weekend, expect an incredible atmosphere at one of the UK's best independent festivals.

moments.title: Biffy Clyro in Edinburgh
moments.blurb: Scottish rock band Biffy Clyro performs at the Royal Highland Showgrounds in Edinburgh on Friday, August 21st, with support from Nothing But Thieves and Swim School.

angles.name: Biffy back home
angles.copy: Edinburgh! Biffy Clyro are playing the Royal Highland Showgrounds this Friday. Get ready for a huge night of Scottish rock!

angles.name: Nothing But Thieves support
angles.copy: Catch Biffy Clyro with Nothing But Thieves and Swim School in Edinburgh this Friday. It’s going to be loud!

moments.title: Guildhall Live Exeter
moments.blurb: Guildhall Live: 50 Years of Music, a free three-day music festival celebrating five decades of hits, takes place in Exeter's Market Square from August 29th-31st.

angles.name: Exeter free festival
angles.copy: Exeter! Get ready for Guildhall Live: 50 Years of Music, a FREE three-day festival in Market Square from August 29-31. Celebrating five decades of hits!

angles.name: Local talent spotlight
angles.copy: Beyond the tribute acts, Guildhall Live will feature local choirs, bands, and dance schools each morning. Come support Devon's amazing talent!

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, turns 68 today, August 17th. Born in 1958.

angles.name: Go-Go's icon
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle! From The Go-Go's to her solo hits, what's your favourite track?

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place On Earth
angles.copy: Celebrating Belinda Carlisle's birthday today! Still making us feel like 'Heaven Is A Place On Earth'. What a legend!

moments.title: Robert Plant's 78th Birthday
moments.blurb: Led Zeppelin frontman and rock icon Robert Plant celebrates his 78th birthday on Thursday, August 20th. Born in 1948.

angles.name: Rock God birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the legendary Robert Plant! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin song?

angles.name: Voice of a generation
angles.copy: From 'Stairway to Heaven' to his incredible solo work, Robert Plant turns 78 this Thursday. A true rock god!

moments.title: Kelis's 47th Birthday
moments.blurb: Grammy-nominated singer Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', turns 47 on Friday, August 21st. Born in 1979.

angles.name: Milkshake birthday
angles.copy: Happy 47th Birthday to the iconic Kelis! Who remembers when 'Milkshake' took over the charts?

angles.name: Timeless R&B
angles.copy: From 'Caught Out There' to her genre-bending collaborations, Kelis celebrates her birthday this Friday! What's your top Kelis track?

moments.title: Dua Lipa's 31st Birthday
moments.blurb: Global pop sensation Dua Lipa, known for her chart-topping hits and electrifying performances, celebrates her 31st birthday on Saturday, August 22nd. Born in 1995.

angles.name: Pop superstar birthday
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa! From 'New Rules' to 'Radical Optimism', she keeps delivering the bangers. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Future Nostalgia Queen
angles.copy: Celebrating Dua Lipa's birthday this Saturday! Get those dance moves ready, because her music always makes you want to move.

moments.title: Gene Simmons' 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: KISS bassist and co-lead singer Gene Simmons, known as 'The Demon', turns 77 on Tuesday, August 25th. Born in 1949.

angles.name: KISS legend birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Gene Simmons! What's your favourite KISS anthem to blast loud?

angles.name: The Demon turns 77
angles.copy: Rock 'n' Roll All Nite and party every day! Celebrating KISS icon Gene Simmons' birthday this Tuesday. The legend lives on!

moments.title: Shirley Manson's 60th Birthday
moments.blurb: Scottish singer Shirley Manson, lead vocalist of the alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday on Wednesday, August 26th. Born in 1966.

angles.name: Garbage frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the fierce and fabulous Shirley Manson! What's your go-to Garbage track?

angles.name: Iconic Scottish voice
angles.copy: Celebrating Shirley Manson's milestone birthday this Wednesday! A true rock icon from Scotland, still pushing boundaries with Garbage.
